d:
In a school in Panchkula, Haryana, an 8-year-old boy severely assaulted a 6-year-old girl inside a classroom. He struck her on the head with a brick and trampled her with his feet. The reason behind this incident had remained a mystery—until now. For the first time, the girl's family has issued a statement addressing this question.
